summary: Alpex Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its IPO of 11.5M units at $10/unit (including over-allotment) for $115M gross proceeds, and a concurrent private placement of 187.5K units to its sponsor for $1.875M. The proceeds were placed in a trust account with Equiniti Trust Company for the benefit of public shareholders. As a blank-check SPAC, this filing merely documents the IPO closing and trust funding; no business combination, tender, or other special situation is announced. The only notable watch item is the eventual target announcement within the SPAC's 24-month deadline.
